Syncly.subtitle: Professional Networking Platform
Syncly.description: Syncly is a cross-sector professional networking platform Vigneshwaran built from scratch. It lets technical and non-technical professionals connect, collaborate, and share projects. Features include real-time chat via Socket.IO with typing indicators and active user tracking, a custom portfolio builder (no-code, form-driven), AWS EC2 deployment with optimized builds, AWS SES for automated onboarding and notification emails, and a cron job for daily email digests. The backend uses modular REST APIs.
Syncly.role: Solo full-stack development, backend APIs, AWS deployment

GlycanBench.subtitle: Glycomics AI Platform
GlycanBench.description: GlycanBench is an interactive glycomics research platform hosted at SASTRA University. It lets researchers analyze, visualize, and manipulate glycan structures. Vigneshwaran integrated multiple deep learning models — BiLSTM, XGBoost, GAT, GIN, MPNN — for immunogenicity prediction, achieving up to 98.2% accuracy. The platform also supports motif extraction and mutation analysis. Backend is FastAPI/Flask (Python), frontend is React.js with Tailwind CSS.
GlycanBench.role: ML model development and evaluation, full-stack development

EGFR Inhibitors for Ovarian Cancer.subtitle: Drug Discovery via Explainable AI
EGFR Inhibitors for Ovarian Cancer.description: Vigneshwaran built an explainable ML framework to discover potent EGFR inhibitors targeting ovarian cancer. Using ChEMBL bioactivity data, he built a cheminformatics pipeline with RDKit and Mordred for 1800+ molecular descriptors. After Lasso feature selection, Gradient Boosting achieved 92% accuracy and Random Forest 94.28%. SHAP explanations identified key molecular features (PEOE_VSA9, SM_VSA10, pic50) and produced force/waterfall plots for interpretability.

Lignocellulosic Bioethanol Prediction.subtitle: ML for Green Energy
Lignocellulosic Bioethanol Prediction.description: ML models for predicting lignocellulosic components (cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin) and fermentable sugars in biomass for bioethanol production. Multiple pretreatment methods were studied. Models trained: MLR, Decision Tree, Random Forest, SVM. He also built the BFuel website to host the dataset and predictions.

QSPR for Posaconazole SEDDS.subtitle: Pharmaceutical Formulation Modeling
QSPR for Posaconazole SEDDS.description: QSPR models to predict Posaconazole solubility in Self-Emulsifying Drug Delivery Systems (SEDDS). Formulation components encoded with quantum chemical descriptors. VIF analysis eliminated multicollinearity. Random Forest achieved R² up to 0.926, outperforming MLR, KNN, and SVM.

Guazuma ulmifolia Bioethanol Suitability.subtitle: West Indian Elm as Bioethanol Feedstock
Guazuma ulmifolia Bioethanol Suitability.description: Evaluated Guazuma ulmifolia (West Indian Elm) fruit as a bioethanol feedstock via chemical pretreatment, proximate analysis, and fermentable sugar quantification to assess its suitability for bioethanol production.

CJFoods.subtitle: MERN Food Delivery App
CJFoods.description: A scalable MERN-based food delivery platform integrating the Swiggy API for live restaurant and menu data. Features real-time UI updates and optimized performance.

TinDog.subtitle: Responsive Landing Page
TinDog.description: A playful dog-dating website built with Bootstrap and HTML, designed to master responsive layout and component patterns.

CJBoT — Cookie.subtitle: Autonomous Singing Biped Robot
CJBoT — Cookie.description: CJBoT (Cookie) is an autonomous singing biped robot built on Arduino Nano ATMEGA328. It detects obstacles with sensors and navigates independently while performing.
